_comment: Values that are not ChatGPT custom properties, or that the measured elements settle: read from the real elements in the signed-in page copies (raw/layout.json and raw/components-computed.json). Every leaf names where it was read. Dimensions are CSS pixels.

thread-max-width.source: measured: the thread column (`div.mx-auto.flex-1.group/turn-messages`, max-width 768px) and the markdown body, x 466 at 1440 with the sidebar open (layout.json)

composer-width.source: measured: the composer box on home, a thread, a project and Images, the same 768 column (layout.json); `--composer-bar_width` defaults to 768px

composer-height.source: measured: the one-row composer at rest on desktop (components-computed.json, composer); `--composer-bar_height` defaults to 52px

composer-height-phone.source: measured: the two-row composer at 390 wide, 358x87 at x 16 (m-composer)

phone-gutter.source: measured: the composer and thread column start at x 16 at 390 wide (layout.json, mobile-*)

content-max-width.source: measured: `max-w-app-content`, the 800 wide column with 16px padding that holds the Images, Plugins and project pages (layout.json)

library-max-width.source: measured: the Library toolbar and list, 1092 wide from x 308 inside 48px side padding at 1440 (layout.json, library-dark)

search-dialog-width.source: measured: the search dialog panel, 720x462 at (360, 195) (search-dialog)

user-bubble-max-width.source: measured: 70% of the 768 thread column (`--user-chat-width: 70%`), 537.6 wide (user-bubble)

row.source: measured: sidebar nav, chat and project rows, settings tabs, accent options (`.__menu-item`, rounded-[10px])

control.source: measured: sidebar icon buttons, the wordmark link, Share, the header Upgrade, settings select buttons (rounded-lg)

menu-item.source: measured: chat menu, user menu and + menu items (12px inside the popover)

popover.source: measured: the chat row menu, user menu, + menu and phone model menu

listbox.source: measured: the accent colour menu (a select listbox, radius 16)

dialog.source: measured: the settings and search dialogs (`--radius-2xl`)

composer-phone.source: measured: the two-row composer at 390 wide

user-bubble.source: measured: the user message bubble on both widths

plugin-row.source: measured: a Plugins row and the 'See more' row (rounded-2xl)

pill.source: measured: rounded-full on the mode toggle, Think chip, round buttons, tabs, search fields and the toggle track (computes to 33554400px)

row-height.source: measured: every sidebar row, menu item and settings tab (`--menu-item-height`, 9 spacing units)

row-inset.source: measured: sidebar rows run from x 6 to 254 inside the 260 sidebar

icon-button.source: measured: sidebar, header, composer and rail icon buttons (36x36)

turn-action.source: measured: the Copy button under an answer (32x32)

icon.source: measured: sidebar, menu and composer icons (20x20; `icon` class), 16 for the small `icon-sm` set

icon-small.source: measured: chevrons, pin, sparkle and the header Upgrade sparkle at 16 (icons/INDEX.tsv sizes)

avatar.source: measured: the account avatar in the sidebar (24x24, rounded-full)

library-row-height.source: measured: a Library list row (60 tall, 60 pitch)

header-padding.source: measured: the page header (52 tall, padding 8)

table-cell-padding-x.source: measured: markdown th and td padding-inline-end 24px

plugin-grid-gap-x.source: measured: the two 384 wide plugin columns are 8 apart (layout.json)

plugin-grid-gap-y.source: measured: plugin rows on a 72 pitch, 56 tall (layout.json)

popover-bg.source: measured: chat row menu, user menu, accent menu and phone model menu fill (`dark:bg-[#353535]` on `.popover`)

popover-shadow-ring.source: measured: the 1px inset ring every popover and the composer carry in dark (box-shadow 0 0 1px inset)

settings-select-bg.source: measured: the settings select buttons are transparent in dark (settings-select)

code-block-surface.source: CSS only, no code block was captured: the code block sets `[--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)]` and `dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)]` and paints `bg-(--code-block-surface)`

popover-bg.source: measured: chat row menu, user menu, accent menu and phone model menu fill in light (`.popover` over `--main-surface-primary`)

popover-shadow-ring.source: measured: the 1px ring of the light composer and popovers (0 0 0 1px #0000000a, then 0 2px 8px and 0 4px 80px 8px soft layers)

settings-select-bg.source: measured: the settings select buttons in light (settings-select)

code-block-surface.source: CSS only, no code block was captured: `[--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)]` on the code block, `bg-(--code-block-surface)`
